'''Uncle Dong''' is an NPC in {{Location|Jinzhou}}.

==Location==

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Uncle Dong}}

==Idle Quotes==
:{{DIcon}} That was quite a show back in the day, wasn't it?
:{{DIcon}} I just don't believe that [[Qinghe]]'s new play can actually impress me.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Day)
:'''Uncle Dong:''' You guys just don't know what makes a good play!
:'''Uncle Dong:''' Back in my day, those actors were real gluttons for hard work. And that makes them great performers.
----
;(Night)
:'''Uncle Dong:''' Hero Play it's about the story of responsibility, honor, loss and gain.
:'''Uncle Dong:''' Honor and responsibility can easily be confused while burdens may as well bring applause.
:'''Uncle Dong:''' Actors should be able to distinguish the difference, or they fail to play as a hero.
:'''Uncle Dong:''' The Hero Play isn't just for us old folks, it's for the kids too. How many kids started dreaming of becoming heroes after watching Hero Play?
:'''Uncle Dong:''' So, the performers will do their job while we should devote all our heart to the watching.
:'''Uncle Dong:''' After all, life's a stage, and all the men and women are mere players...
{{Dialogue End}}


==Event Dialogue==
===By Moon's Grace===
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(First interaction)
:'''Uncle Dong''': ...Let's see, we've got 21 fireworks and the full moon on the 15th. Together, that makes 36! Six times six! Such a lucky number!
:'''Uncle Dong''': A good omen for a lucky life!
:{{DIcon}} ... I don't understand a word you're saying.
:'''Uncle Dong''': Hehe, it's numerology. It's a bit of a mystery, so don't worry about it.
:'''Uncle Dong''': How about you draw a fortune stick, Rover? These are Sentinel Fortune Sticks, each one corresponding to a specific Sentinel prophecy.
:'''Uncle Dong''': A good draw will bring you luck and fortune.
:{{DIcon}} What if I get a bad one?
:'''Uncle Dong''': Just laugh it off! It's only a divination, no big deal.
:'''Uncle Dong''': Besides, with the Sentinel's blessings on this special day, how could you possibly get a bad draw?
:{{DIcon}} ... Don't tell me they're all good draws.
:'''Uncle Dong''': Well, well, if you say it out loud, the luck might not work.
----
:'''Uncle Dong:''' Draw a fortune stick for luck and blessings! See into the future, see for yourself!

:{{DIcon}} Chat
::'''Uncle Dong:''' I got into divination from watching those plays about our heroes.
::'''Uncle Dong:''' You know, they always start as nobodies until they meet a divination master who sets them on the right path.
::'''Uncle Dong:''' An opportunity, isn't it? That's why I decided to learn divination myself.
::'''Uncle Dong:''' I thought I was getting pretty good, so I tried using divination to find my lost glasses.
::'''Uncle Dong:''' First try said they were under the bed. The second try, on the rooftop. The third try, in my pocket.
::{{DIcon}} So, where were they exactly?
::'''Uncle Dong:''' Well, I couldn't find them anywhere, so I just bought a new pair.
::'''Uncle Dong:''' That's when I realized divination isn't as magical as in those hero plays.
::'''Uncle Dong:''' It's mostly for fun. No need to take it too seriously. But hey, it's not bad to believe in something... Maybe I just need a bit more practice.
